integrity: All tournaments of orders one through seven are exhaustively enumerated. Banks and uncovered sets are computed directly, the classical inclusion is checked on every case, every divergent order-seven tournament is canonicalized under all vertex relabelings, and a separate Python implementation independently checks the four canonical representatives.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is a complete finite classification for tournaments of order seven. The lower-order equality and the fact that order seven is the first possible disparity are prior results; no larger-order frequency formula is claimed.
title: Complete seven-alternative Banks–uncovered disparity census
